description: Welcome to the INDIA GOT SPOT 1.0 - by Swastik Community! A hackathon bringing Software Development ideas into the spotlight. About the Opportunity: INDIA GOT SPOT 1.0 is a Swastik Community hackathon focused on Software Development. It welcomes team participation and combines a project submission round with a grand offline round. Bring your ideas forward, shape them into a project, and present your work through the submission process. The opportunity offers teams a platform to take part in a software development-focused hackathon and showcase their solutions. Themes/Problem Statements: The grand offline round invites solutions across these areas: AI, Web Technologies, FinTech, Web3, Open Source, and other emerging domains. Competition Structure: The provided structure for INDIA GOT SPOT 1.0 is as follows: INDIA GOT SPOT 1.0 — Project Submission Round: Submit one PowerPoint presentation of no more than six slides. The first slide must include the team name, project or prototype name, GitHub repository link, working prototype link, and demo video link. Use the remaining slides to cover the problem statement, proposed solution, key features, workflow, tech stack, USP or innovation, and impact. Grand Offline Round of India Got Spot 1.0: Shortlisted participants take part in a 8-hour hackathon focused on innovation, creativity, and technology. Build and showcase solutions across the stated domains. Take the next step and get ready to showcase your work.

Welcome to the INDIA GOT SPOT 1.0 - by Swastik Community!

A hackathon bringing Software Development ideas into the spotlight.

About the Opportunity:

INDIA GOT SPOT 1.0 is a Swastik Community hackathon focused on Software Development. It welcomes team participation and combines a project submission round with a grand offline round.

Bring your ideas forward, shape them into a project, and present your work through the submission process. The opportunity offers teams a platform to take part in a software development-focused hackathon and showcase their solutions.

Themes/Problem Statements:

The grand offline round invites solutions across these areas:

  • AI, Web Technologies, FinTech, Web3, Open Source, and other emerging domains.

Competition Structure:

The provided structure for INDIA GOT SPOT 1.0 is as follows:

  • INDIA GOT SPOT 1.0 — Project Submission Round: Submit one PowerPoint presentation of no more than six slides. The first slide must include the team name, project or prototype name, GitHub repository link, working prototype link, and demo video link. Use the remaining slides to cover the problem statement, proposed solution, key features, workflow, tech stack, USP or innovation, and impact.
  • Grand Offline Round of India Got Spot 1.0: Shortlisted participants take part in a 8-hour hackathon focused on innovation, creativity, and technology. Build and showcase solutions across the stated domains.

    Contact Details:

    • Bhavika - +91 9205969968
